svg.title: GTW Outback corrected interlock and fascia principle
svg.desc: A simple pair of recessed C-channels capture a true H-section key. Separate front and rear fascia views show rubber pads only on the cabinet-facing rear, with folded locating tabs and a basic cam.

g.text: Recessed into the cases. Open faces meet.
One flange inside each C-channel; no spacer between cases.

svg.text: Two flanges joined by one web. Slides lengthwise.
Turn 90° for the stacked-cabinet section at left.
03 / THE SAME FLAT FASCIA — TWO DISTINCT FACES
Clean finished face. No rubber or foam visible.
Thin pads press against the cabinet face.
Plain one-piece cover strip hides channels and keeper pin.
Tabs cut and folded from the plate
Cam and pads face the cabinet. No keyhole on this side.
Concept only · proportions illustrative · not dimensioned
